artworks.title: The Fire, 2nd plate (L'incendie)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts two groups of figures in a dark, shadowy setting. On the left, a person is sitting or crouching, supporting a child who is held in their lap and reaching out to another child who is climbing onto them. The person has tired or downcast facial features and tousled hair. To the right, there are two women; one is seated, embracing a child against her, with her head turned towards the left side of the image. The child, nestled closely to her, appears to be leaning on her lap, their back towards the viewer. Both women wear dresses with full sleeves. The setting around them includes broken pieces of furniture or wooden elements scattered on the ground. The background is densely shaded, suggesting a rocky or cavernous area dimly lit, deepening the contrast between the figures and their surroundings.

artworks.title: Ex-Libris Edwin Edwards
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a stone building with a round tower in the distance, surrounded by trees. The building is off-center to the left, with a path leading to the right. The brushstrokes are fine and create textures and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, using black ink and the natural paper tone for contrast. In the foreground, there is a large dog next to a stone plaque. The composition leads the eye from the foreground to the trees and path in the background.

artworks.title: Archers (Les archers)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image portrays a group of seven men standing closely together within a confined space. They are all depicted from the waist up, facing various directions. The man on the far left has distinct facial features and is slightly positioned forward. He wears ornate garments with a detailed pattern and has short, rounded hair. The other men wear layers of clothing and various hat styles, suggesting historical fashion. They have a mix of bearded and clean-shaven faces and hold staffs or spears. The background is minimalistic with linear designs, resembling a decorative wall or structure.

artworks.title: "Since Then" ("Depuis ce temps-la")
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays an elderly man sitting under a tree. He is seen in profile, with a relaxed posture and his upper body slightly leaning forward. The man appears aged, with facial lines, a prominent nose, and thinning hair. He is wearing a long-sleeve shirt, a partially buttoned vest, and pants. A hat is placed beside him, and he seems to be holding an object. In the background, there are rolling fields and scattered tree branches. A jug or earthen vessel is on the ground near him.

artworks.title: Death and the Woodcutter, 3rd plate (La mort et le bucheron)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a field. The figure on the left is crouched down, holding harvested wheat and a hand sickle. The person has a beard, wears a cap, and appears focused. The figure on the right stands behind the first one, holding a scythe over their shoulder. Their face is partially visible in profile. The background includes fields, trees, and a sky with linear etchings.

artworks.title: Fagot-makers (Les faiseurs de fagots)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene with figures working by a tree. The drawing depicts a detailed representation of a natural, agrarian setting, focusing on a pair of workers engaged in gathering or cutting branches from a barren, twisted tree. The figures are rendered with precision and attention to the texture of their clothing and the branches they are handling, highlighting the rough, labor-intensive nature of their task. The tree itself is a central element, depicted with gnarled branches and rich texture, giving a sense of resilience and timelessness. The background is minimally detailed, emphasizing the earthy, labor-centric foreground activity.

artworks.title: Fagot-makers (Les faiseurs de fagots)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from head to toe. The person on the left stands upright, wrapped in what appears to be a cloak or robe, with their head covered, showing only the face. The facial expression is calm and focused. The second person is bent over, holding a sickle in their right hand. They wear a long-sleeved shirt with rolled-up sleeves, trousers, and knee-length boots. The background includes a large, leafless tree on the right and a grassy, uneven landscape, indicating a rural setting. The etching technique used creates a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Head of a Philosopher (Tete de philosophe)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a drawing of a person's head and upper torso. The individual is facing forward with their head slightly tilted downwards. They have deep-set eyes, a long beard extending below the chin, and long unkempt hair. The drawing emphasizes intricate details of the facial features and hair, with no visible clothing. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Auguste Poulet-Malassis, 2nd plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body, focusing on his head and shoulders. The man is positioned in a three-quarters view and is looking slightly towards his left. His facial features are detailed, with a prominent nose and a well-groomed beard that connects to a mustache. His hair is receding, emphasizing his forehead. The man is wearing a jacket over a shirt with a short tie or cravat visible. The artwork is done in an etching style with fine lines creating depth and texture. The background consists of horizontal lines and features a signature "A. Legros" at the bottom right.

artworks.title: Head of a Man (Tete d'homme)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man's head and partial upper torso in a frontal position. The man has his head tilted slightly to one side, with distinct facial features including closed eyes, prominent cheekbones, a straight nose, and a full, textured beard blending into his short, wavy hair. He appears serene with fine line work accentuating his hair and beard. The man seems unclothed, with bare shoulders visible at the bottom of the image. There are no additional objects, and the background is a plain, blank canvas emphasizing the man's face and upper chest.

artworks.title: Head of a Man (Tete d'homme)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This image is a portrait of a man in profile view, showing only his head and a portion of his shoulder. The man has a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, a bushy beard, and dark, closely cropped hair. He is wearing a dark-colored coat or jacket with a plain, dark background.

artworks.title: Village of Wimille, near Boulogne  (Village de Wimille, pres Boulogne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape etching with a wide-angle view from an elevated position. A village and trees are visible on the horizon. The etching features fine lines and cross-hatching to depict texture and depth in the foliage, clouds, and terrain. The color palette is subdued, primarily sepia tones. In the foreground, there are patches of scrub or low bushes with darker strokes.

artworks.title: Charity (La charite)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated person with a bowl and two individuals standing nearby. The image depicts a scene where a person is seated on the ground, holding a bowl in their hand, with two staffs resting beside them. The person appears to be wearing old and tattered clothing. Two individuals stand in front of the seated figure; both are draped in cloaks, and one is holding something in their hand. The background includes an architectural element, possibly a large column or wall. The drawing uses detailed line work to convey texture and suggests a narrative of charity or social interaction.

artworks.title: Beggar (Le mendiant)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body. He is standing in a slight profile facing towards the right side of the image. The man has an aged appearance, with prominent cheekbones and a bushy beard. He has a bald head with hair around the sides. He wears loose-fitting clothing with folds, a long-sleeved garment. He holds a hat in his left hand and a walking stick in his right hand. The background is plain, with no additional details, signatures, and a date in the top and bottom corners.

artworks.title: Sir Seymour Haden
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a profile portrait of a man with distinctive facial features. He is facing left, with short wavy hair and sideburns. The lighting creates shadows that accentuate his nose and chin. He is wearing a dark coat, blending into the shadows. The background is softly textured with gradients, enhancing the contrast in the image.

artworks.title: Vase with Grotesques (Le vase aux masques)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a sculpture of three human faces carved into a rounded rectangular object. The central face has a calm expression and a headband, while the side faces are bearded. The sculpture is in monochrome, with shading and lines indicating a stone-like material, possibly marble. The etching style adds detailed textures and shadows for dimension. The intricate facial features and drapery suggest a significant artistic work with historical or cultural themes.

artworks.title: Digger (Le piocheur)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a man working in agriculture. The man is bent over with a tool in his hands. The horizon is low, with distant buildings and trees visible. The drawing uses fine lines to show texture in the man's clothing and the landscape. The man is focused on his task, with a sack nearby. Fields stretch into the distance, with vegetation. The color palette is monochrome with light brown tones.

artworks.title: Burning Grass (Le bruleur d'herbes)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person bending down with a basket. The image features an individual with a basket on a textured surface. The figure is shown in a bent-over posture, and the background is minimalistic. The style is basic and characteristic of line drawings.

artworks.title: Small Satyr Mask (Petit masque de satyre)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of an older man's head and part of his neck. The man is shown in a slightly angled position with his head tilted downward. His facial features include a pronounced nose, creased forehead with deep lines, and eyes that appear to be looking downward or closed. He has a full, bushy beard and his hair is minimal or possibly bald, as suggested by the outline. The style of his beard and hair suggests a rough texture, emphasized by the sketch lines. He does not appear to be wearing any visible clothing or jewelry. The background is plain, emphasizing the etched lines and shadows that make up his facial details.

artworks.title: Frontispiece (The Beggar Woman of Veze)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an elderly woman. She is bent over with her right hand extended outward. She has detailed facial features, a serene expression, and a headscarf covering her hair. She is wearing a long-sleeved garment that reaches her ankles and is barefoot. In the background, there are sketchy lines suggesting a barren setting.

artworks.title: Vagabond Moving along a Lane (Un vagabond passant dans une ruelle)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: A man is walking down a path. The background shows detailed foliage, trees, and a large tree dominating the left side. The horizon is low on the right, showing a field or rural landscape with a softly sketched sky. The image is rendered in monochromatic shades of sepia or dark brown ink on cream or off-white paper.

artworks.title: Head of a Man (Tete d'homme)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length lithograph of an older man in profile, facing the left side. He has angular features, short wavy hair, a long beard, and simple clothing. The background is a toned textural surface.

artworks.title: Banks of the Marne (Bord de la Marne)
artworks.medium: drypoint and (etching?) on light green paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon slightly above the center. On the horizon are trees depicted with loose brushstrokes suggesting motion. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia and black shades on an off-white background. In the foreground, there is a body of water with tree reflections. Soft foliage frames the scene on the sides, and more trees are visible in the distance with varying line weights to depict shapes and textures.

artworks.title: Interior of a Church (Interieur d'eglise)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows several figures in cloaks standing in an architectural setting. The figures are in front of a building with columns and arches. They appear to be engaged in a quiet activity. Detailed elements of the room, such as a window and a stand, are visible in the background. The overall atmosphere is somber and textured, characteristic of etching techniques.
